run_download_and_extract: run the script to download TED talks tarball and extract TSV files to a target directory
run_extract_bitex: run the script with a direction list to extract bilingual TED talk pairs for multiple language directions
run_extract_english: run the script with extract-all-english flag to extract English-only text from all TED talk splits
review_MultiLingualAlignedCorpusReader: review the MultiLingualAlignedCorpusReader class that reads and filters multilingual TED talk aligned corpus data
refactor_extra_bitex: refactor the extra_bitex function to extract bilingual TED talk pairs for a given source and target language
